---
title: "CPU and memory"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
summary <- lb_table("summary")
reps <- lb_table("repetitions")
```

Resource measurements of included repetitions with complete monitoring
(`monitoring_status = available`). Partial, unavailable or disabled monitoring is
counted (`n_partial_monitoring`, `n_monitoring_missing`) and never filled with
zeros. Process-tree values belong to the benchmarked process and its children;
whole-machine values include unrelated activity and the monitor itself. CPU time
marked as a lower bound missed short-lived children. Brief peaks can be missed
between samples.

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_kable(summary[summary$section != "no_measurements", , drop = FALSE],
         c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool", "n_included", "n_monitored",
           "n_partial_monitoring", "n_monitoring_missing", "tree_cpu_seconds_mean",
           "tree_cpu_seconds_sd", "tree_cpu_seconds_is_lower_bound", "tree_peak_rss_bytes_mean",
           "tree_peak_rss_bytes_max", "machine_cpu_percent_mean", "machine_cpu_percent_sd",
           "machine_memory_used_peak_bytes_max"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
if (!is.null(reps) && nrow(reps)) lb_plot_resources(reps)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_download("repetitions", "Download per-repetition resources (repetitions.csv)")
```
